en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, gently curving street lined with multi‑story buildings on both sides. The right side has gabled roofs and shopfronts, while the left side shows long facades with many windows. A horse‑drawn carriage, a few pedestrians, and two children in dresses and hats stand in the foreground. Trees rise behind the buildings on the right. The caption at the top reads 'GRAZ – Wieckenburggasse'.
